description: A direct regular triangle installs the core facet AC, but a later coface containing AC has ten strict interior witnesses before an unvisited exact shell point. A closed-rank cutoff can therefore finish before observing the shell and cannot certify global regularity of Star(D_k).
contradicted_claim: A complete higher-support stream whose rank-pruned products emitted no relevant extra-shell diagnostic certifies the global regularity required for every late coface in Star(D_k).
scope_note: The fixture does not contradict the exact rank-prune decision: AB already has closed rank twelve before Y is visited. It contradicts only promotion of that cutoff receipt into shell closure or global Star regularity.
